excerpt_i18n.en: On October 22, marking the 10th anniversary of NetEase YunXin's establishment, the brand upgrade and autumn product launch themed "Hello, AI 'New' Life" was held in Beijing. At the event, NetEase YunXin announced an upgrade to its brand positioning and released a comprehensive intelligent integrated communication capabilities map along with a series of AI products and applications, aiming to embrace AI more extensively and deliver more tangible value to enterprise clients across various industries. NetEase YunXin: A decade of honing, trust in all things. According to the latest data from the China Internet Network Information Center, as of June 2025, China's internet user base had reached 1.123 billion, with internet penetration continuing to rise, and mobile internet users accounting for over 99.4% of the total. Living in the digital world, we experience scenes like this daily: when a phone notification sounds, you skillfully unlock the screen, open an app, and communicate effortlessly with friends and family far away—it has become the most ordinary part of everyday life. Today, nearly all applications have the capability for instant messaging, and replying to messages amid a dazzling array of apps feels as natural as breathing to users. However, 10 years ago, achieving such "natural breathing" was not easy. In 2015, during the early stages of the mobile internet startup era, with limited development resources and project budgets, building a stable and reliable instant messaging architecture in applications posed a significant barrier for most companies. This is what NetEase YunXin was doing at the time—providing instant messaging capabilities in the form of an SDK.
excerpt_i18n.es: El 22 de octubre, con motivo del décimo aniversario de NetEase YunXin, se celebró en Pekín una conferencia de actualización de marca y presentación de productos de otoño bajo el lema "Hello, AI 'Nuevo' Nacimiento".
